title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Settings: Insurer Direct Billing and Desk Goodwill Authority
content:
Two settings of Repair Estimates & Appointments decide who may settle estimate-stage charges and how much the desk may waive as goodwill.

| Estimate type | Insurer may settle estimate-stage charges directly | Desk goodwill authority per booking |
|---|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | No | 0.00 USD |
| Drive-In Estimate | No | 0.00 USD |
| Scheduled Estimate | No | 25.00 USD |
| Mobile Estimate | No | 39.00 USD |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | Yes | 95.00 USD |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | Yes | 95.00 USD |

- **Insurer direct billing** — whether estimate-stage charges on an insurance-claim booking may be settled by the insurer directly.
- **Desk goodwill authority** — the most the desk may waive as goodwill across all charges of one booking.

Direct settlement by the insurer is open only on the Blueprint Teardown Estimate and the Structural Blueprint Estimate. The goodwill authority is 0.00 USD on the Photo and Drive-In Estimates, 25.00 USD on the Scheduled Estimate, 39.00 USD on the Mobile Estimate and 95.00 USD on both teardown types.
